The 2014 triple-dot source uses end injection and stationary transport and does not directly imply the central-source first-passage theorem. Prior same-topic own records treat middle-only dephasing from site1, not uniform dephasing with site2 initial. Novelty assessment remains provisional pending an external independent literature audit.

value.rationale: The center-initialized trimer is a natural preparation already highlighted for clean chains in Zhang et al. 2017; disorder at its initially occupied site is physically motivated. A matched extraction rate balances coherent hopping and loss. A fully exact, globally unique optimal dephasing setting at all detunings with strict monotonicity and sharp asymptotic scaling is a nontrivial control conclusion, beyond a routine substitution.
